question: What alternative forms may the central structure take in this construction?
premises: The structure may be furnished with an inner sanctum.
The structure may alternatively be furnished with devotion in the middle.
The verse presents these as alternatives.
inference: The central structure may be made either with an inner sanctum or with devotion.
uncertainties: The sense of bhaktiyutaṃ as a structural or ritual qualification is ambiguous.
plain_english: Alternatively, one may make it in the middle with an inner sanctum, or with devotion.
